'''Grand Admiral Tsung Seeing Red v.1''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 29 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 ROps Tsung DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

See Guard.

See Guard react.

React, Guard, React!!!

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Sorry for all the abbreviation, but this is the third time I've tried to submit.

Inconsiquential losses- provides forfeitable cards that go into your used pile.

Emergency Deployment- As this deck has few interrupts/effects, this card is highly effective. Use it right before you react away.

Cane adiss- use to ambush with guards (takes away deployment restrictions)

Myn-Place at DSII D-Bay and use guards to force drain at D-bays. They can react for free to his site (does this get rid of D-Bay transit costs?).

General- Flip as quickly as possible. Then pull your stronger characters. Contnously pull D-bay. If they are on ground, don't pull all the sites. If in space, drain them till they wish they had a ground deck. Use Your Darths' to anihilate whatever resistance they put up. (okay, yet another brute force deck...)
